sections.content_text: Section 334 - Power to Condone or Extend Time, etc. Notwithstanding anything contained in any other provision of this Act, in cases where there is a declaration or order of the Government stating that there is an epidemic, pandemic, natural calamity and wartime, the Board may, in the public interest, with the prior approval of the Government, by issuing such order, condone the limitation of compliance period or extend the compliance period.
